description: Opt-in access to Chrome on the Linux session device. The device issues scoped routing handles. Controllers continue to execute their own Chrome actions through clientTools.

litch/remoteChrome/configure.authorization: The local Chrome user CLI reads the current service proof from a private file. It is not issued to model tools or device clients.

routing.handles: Issued by the session device for the active harness, session and turn. Claims are single use. All actions in one batch must resolve to one execution end.
routing.approval: One device-issued prompt with a nonce bound to the in-flight request, forwarded only to an authorized desktop connection. Phone projections are read-only.
